# Keep focus stable when an edited opportunity leaves the active filter

## What & Why
If an opportunity is edited from a filtered queue and its status changes so it no longer matches that filter, the original edit button disappears when the dialog closes. The current fallback is the page-level add button, but a nearby queue or filter control would preserve context better.

## Done looks like
- Editing an opportunity and changing its status keeps focus in the queue even when the edited card is removed from the current filter.
- The fallback target is deterministic and has an accessible name.
- Browser coverage verifies the filtered edit flow.
